status: FROZEN RESEARCH SPEC -- optional component; see CFB_V2_DATA_ENRICHMENT_REPORT.md for the evidence and the primary recommendation

base.unchanged: V2-TOTAL, V2-WINNER derivation, uncertainty model, continuity correction, folds, alpha grid, missing-value policy

component.hypothesis: the market prices a persistent, within-season team-level drift that V2's decayed state under-weights; V2's own prior-game residuals recover part of it

features.selfcorr_cum: for each side, mean over the team's PRIOR games this season of (V2 pred_margin - actual margin) from the team's perspective, shrunk by n/(n+3); feature = home value - away value; 0 when a side has no prior game
features.selfcorr_prev: same using only the team's most recent prior game; 0 when absent

component.timing_rule: uses only games that finished strictly before the game's kickoff; the V2 predictions used are the model's own out-of-sample predictions for those games (historically: rolling-origin fold predictions; in production: the live 0.x prediction recorded in the observation ledger at the time). Never uses the target game or any later game.
component.preprocessing: appended to both V2-MARGIN members' feature sets (struct+pre -> 40 features, eff+pre -> 66), standardised with the rest; training-median fill (0 by construction)
component.model: identical to V2-MARGIN: equal-weight mean of two standardised ridge regressions; alpha chosen on the inner validation season from {1,10,100,1000}; refit on all seasons < Y
component.training_cutoff: all completed FBS-vs-FBS games through the 2025 postseason; NO 2026 game result
component.predictions_file: docs/v2/enrichment/enr_selfcorr.json (metrics); preds on scratch reproduced by scripts/v2_enrich/enrich_eval.py

evidence.market_gap_closed: no: V2+selfcorr vs close paired delta +0.373 [+0.241, +0.489] on common 2021-2025 games

acceptance_assessment: MODEST, borderline-repeatable (7 of 8 folds non-worse, pooled interval excludes zero, common-set interval does not). Does not alter the market comparison, calibration, or large-disagreement side accuracy. Not sufficient on its own to justify a distinct production model version; documented for a future productionization mission to include only if it survives a second season of prospective evidence.
